name: @partnera/creator-desktop
description: Partnera Creator — Windows desktop thin client (Tauri 2). A creator-only desktop app that loads the Creator Portal (/creator) from the central Partnera API over HTTPS. No bundled runtime and no local database: the central API is the single source of truth (packages/web on Railway → shared Postgres). Separate product from Partnera Operations, Business, Affiliate and Internal OS.
